claimText: Für Elise, beginner arrangement: bars 0-8 quote the opening of WoO 59 (values doubled, 3/8 as 3/4) with named changes; bars 9-16 repeat bars 5-8

differenceNotes: bar 1: the C5 before bar 2's A is left out, and the third E is a quarter note to keep the bar full - declared departure (keeps the run of equal notes within the Beginner limit)
bar 3: G4 instead of G#4 - declared departure (no accidentals after bar 1)
bar 4: D5 instead of D#5 - declared departure (no accidentals after bar 1)
bar 5: D5 instead of D#5 - declared departure (bar 5 is E, D, C, B)
bar 5: C5 instead of E5 - declared departure (bar 5 is E, D, C, B)
bar 5: the D5 of Beethoven's figure is left out - declared departure (bar 5 is E, D, C, B)
bar 5: the C5 of Beethoven's figure is left out - declared departure (bar 5 is E, D, C, B)
bar 7: G4 instead of C5 - declared departure (bar 7 repeats bar 3)

outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against Mutopia 931. The pickup and bars 1-8 quote Beethoven with values doubled; the old description hid the C5 left out in bar 1, G for G# (bar 3), D for D# (bar 4), and the shortened bars 5 and 7. They keep the item at Beginner (restoring the C makes a run of 8 equal notes; Beginner is at its minimum), so they are named departures (R10 rule 6). No note changed.
